results.owner_disposition: Theorem1.22/2398-2479 has a genuine two-dimensional H1 nonalgebra application mechanism, but after the already allowed uniform normal-form control its residual is finite truncation, listed Hölder/Gagliardo-Nirenberg continuity, Young/Hölder tail bounds and parameter/time-exponent matching. No new difficult endpoint multilinear estimate, rough symplectic map or infinite-dimensional normal-form construction is supplied here; no independentH2. Do not reject merely because it is an application or rename it a duplicate.

results.owner_disposition: Theorem5.1/1844-1979 is a distinct dynamical conclusion, not a literal duplicate. However old2099 already provides continuous negative-Sobolev derivative extensions, genuine symplectic maps and a controlled normal-form remainder. Residual1862-1887 is an integral difference quotient with continuity/dominatedconvergence;1890-1925 uses symplectic adjoints/inverse/density;1927-1978 differentiates finite quadratic blocks, integrates the remainder and compares the near-identity map. No further independentH2.
